comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Asset-light online two-sided consumer marketplace earning take-rate and lead fees, like Airbnb, though serving home services rather than lodging.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Owns upscale hotels and earns room revenue from real estate; Airbnb is an asset-light platform that owns no lodging.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: B2B travel distribution and airline IT software sold to suppliers and agencies, not a consumer lodging marketplace.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Owns select-service hotels as a lodging REIT; asset-heavy room revenue unlike Airbnb's commission-based marketplace.
